title: 我的家和玩具
intro: Rooms, furniture and toys, and the most useful location patterns in Chinese: thing + 在 + place ('is at') vs place + 有 + thing ('there is'). Measure words grow: 张 for flat things, 把 for things with handles, 辆 for vehicles, 本 for books.

ex.p: zhè shì wǒ de fáng jiān
wǒ de fáng jiān hěn xiǎo
wǒ zài chuáng shàng shuì jiào

ex.en: The book is on the table.

ex.zh: 我们家的桌子是木头的。
ex.p: wǒ men jiā de zhuō zi shì mù tou de
ex.en: Our table is made of wood.

ex.p: zhè bǎ yǐ zi shì wǒ de
xiǎo māo zài yǐ zi xià mian
ex.en: The kitten is under the chair.

ex.p: mén kǒu yǒu yī zhī gǒu
ex.en: There's a dog at the door.

ex.p: chuāng hu wài mian yǒu yī kē shù
ex.en: There's a tree outside the window.

ex.p: tài hēi le kāi dēng ba
ex.en: It's too dark, put the light on!

ex.p: wǒ men kàn diàn shì ba
yé ye xǐ huan kàn diàn shì

items.note: 踢球 kick a ball (football); 打球 play a ball game with hands/rackets.

ex.p: zhè ge qiú shì hóng sè de
wǒ yǒu hěn duō wán jù
zhè shì shéi de wán jù
wǒ yǒu yī liàng xiǎo chē
ex.en: I have a little toy car.

ex.p: mèi mei xǐ huan wán wá wa
ex.en: My little sister likes playing with dolls.

ex.p: zhè ge wá wa hěn piào liang
zhè běn shū shì wǒ de

items.note: 画画儿 huà huàr: to draw pictures (verb + noun).

ex.p: zhè shì wǒ huà de māo
ex.en: This is a cat I drew.

items.note: Beijing and the north say 玩儿 wánr.

ex.p: wǒ men yī qǐ wán ba

ex.en: What do you want to play?

items.note: 找 = look for; 找到 = find (succeed).
Separable: 睡了一个好觉 'had a good sleep'.
在 + place: be located. 在 + verb: be in the middle of doing (宝宝在睡觉).
Noun + 里 = inside it, often neutral li. Also a distance unit (half a km).

ex.en: There are books in the schoolbag.

ex.p: fáng jiān lǐ yǒu yī zhāng chuáng
ex.en: There's a bed in the room.

ex.p: xiǎo gǒu zài wài mian wán
zhuō zi shàng mian yǒu yī gè píng guǒ
ex.en: There's an apple on the table.
The book is on the bed.
The ball is under the bed.

ex.p: zhuō zi xià mian yǒu yī zhī māo
ex.en: There's a cat under the table.

items.note: Southern and Taiwan: 哪里 nǎ lǐ (said ná lǐ).

ex.p: wǒ de wá wa zài nǎr

ex.en: There are lots of people there.

房.h: Door 户 + 方 for the sound.

间.h: Sunlight 日 through a gap in the door 门.

床.h: A wooden 木 frame under a shelter 广.

椅.h: Wood 木 + 奇 qí for the sound.

窗.h: An opening 穴 with a lattice 囱.

户.h: A single-leaf door: half of 門.

灯.h: Fire 火 + 丁 dīng for the sound.

电.h: Lightning flashing out of a cloud.

视.h: 见 see: watch. 电视 = electric seeing.

球.h: Jade 王 + 求 qiú for the sound: a round jade bead.

玩.h: Fiddling with a piece of jade 王: play.

具.h: Two hands holding up a vessel: a utensil.

车.h: A cart seen from above: axle and two wheels.

娃.h: Girl 女 + 圭 for the sound.

书.h: A brush moving across a page.

画.h: A field 田 being drawn inside a frame.

觉.h: In 睡觉 jiào; in 觉得 jué.

起.h: Walk 走 + 己 (oneself): get yourself up.

在.h: A sprout 才 in the earth 土: to exist, be there.

里.h: Fields 田 and soil 土: a village; inside.

找.h: A hand 扌 with a weapon 戈, searching.

哪.h: A mouth 口 asking about 那 (that): which one?

儿.h: A child's two legs. As a suffix it's the northern r-sound.

texts.title: 摇啊摇

lines.p: yáo a yáo yáo dào wài pó qiáo
lines.en: Row, row, row to Grandma's bridge.

lines.p: wài pó jiào wǒ hǎo bǎo bao
lines.en: Grandma calls me her good little baby,

lines.p: táng yī bāo guǒ yī bāo
lines.en: a bag of sweets, a bag of fruit,

lines.p: chī wán bǐngr hái yǒu gāo
lines.en: and after the biscuits there's cake.

notes: A boat song from the Yangtze delta, sung while rocking a baby.
摇 yáo: to row, rock. 饼儿 bǐngr: little biscuit (儿化). 糕 gāo: cake.

texts.title: 找娃娃

lines.p: mèi mei de wá wa bù jiàn le
wǒ de wá wa zài nǎr mèi mei kū le
zài chuáng shàng ma bù zài
zài zhuō zi xià mian ma yě bù zài
lines.en: Under the table? Not there either.

lines.p: zài mén wài mian ma yě bù zài
lines.en: Outside the door? Not there either.

lines.zh: 小狗跑来了，嘴里有一个娃娃！
lines.p: xiǎo gǒu pǎo lái le zuǐ li yǒu yī gè wá wa
lines.en: The puppy came running with a doll in its mouth!

lines.p: mèi mei xiào le yuán lái zài zhèr
lines.en: Little sister laughed: 'So that's where it was!'

notes: 不见了: has gone missing. 原来 yuán lái: 'so it turns out…', the moment of discovery.

exercises.why: Place + 有 + thing = there is. Thing + 在 + place = is at.
Place + 有 + number + measure word + noun. No 在 at the start.
Location uses 在: 在哪儿？

exercises.en: There's a cat under the table.
exercises.p: zhuō zi xià mian yǒu yī zhī māo
mā ma zài fáng jiān lǐ kàn shū
exercises.en: Mom is reading in her room.

exercises.p: chuáng xià mian yǒu yī gè qiú
exercises.en: There's a ball under the bed.

exercises.why: 玩具 toy · 好玩 fun · 玩球 play ball.
在 + verb = in the middle of doing.
Flat surfaces: 一张床, 一张桌子, 一张纸.
Things you grip by a handle or back: 一把椅子, 一把伞.

scenario.title: 收拾房间
scenario.setting: Your room is a mess. Mom is making you tidy it, item by item.

a.npc: 你的房间太乱了！我们一起收拾吧。
a.p: nǐ de fáng jiān tài luàn le wǒ men yī qǐ shōu shi ba
a.en: Your room is way too messy! Let's tidy it together.

opts.en: I don't want to tidy up.
opts.fb: Honest, but Mom won't accept it. (不想 bù xiǎng)

opts.en: There's a ball under the bed.

opts.fb: Location takes 在, not 是: 球在床下面.

c.p: shū ne shū zài zhuō zi shàng ma
c.en: And your books? Are they on the desk?

opts.p: bù zài shū zài yǐ zi shàng
opts.fb: Answer with the verb in the question: 在 / 不在.
She asked with 在, so answer 不在.

d.npc: 好。把玩具放在箱子里，好吗？
d.p: hǎo bǎ wán jù fàng zài xiāng zi lǐ hǎo ma
d.en: OK. Put the toys in the box, all right?

opts.fb: 我来 + verb = let me do it.

opts.p: wǒ zhǎo bu dào wá wa
opts.fb: 找不到 = can't find (more in Stage 3).

e.npc: 你看，房间干净了！你真棒！
e.p: nǐ kàn fáng jiān gān jìng le nǐ zhēn bàng
e.en: Look, the room's clean! Well done!
